issues.problem: The AI mark uses a Helvetica-style stack that falls back to a DejaVu-like sans in the render, so it looks slightly rounder than the source. Letter-spacing 0.5 is applied only to the Latin mark, which is acceptable.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: use a Latin face verified to be loaded, or Vazirmatn 700.

issues.problem: The remaining glyph icons (◎ ✉ ◧ ◈ ★ ⚑) still come from system font fallback. They render fine in the checked frames, but the SVG arrow is a stroked glyph that is slightly heavier and has a filled arrow tip compared with the source thin U+21BA. This is cosmetic.
issues.suggestedFix: Optional: reduce strokeWidth to about 1.5 to match the weight.

notes: Round-3 check: re-rendered frames 0,8,20,45,60,90,107 with the harness and viewed fa vs orig. The U+21BA glyph is now an inline SVG (open counter-clockwise circular arrow with an arrowhead at the upper left) and reads clearly as a refresh icon at f90 and f107; on a zoomed crop there is no stray curl. The main finding is truly fixed. Persian labels are idiomatic with correct ZWNJ, ی/ک and the ezafe mark on برنامهٔ; there is no letter-spacing on Persian, no overflow, and each row is a single line. The vertical travel, order, outQuint snap, hold, breath and gradient fades match the source and are correctly not mirrored. The icon sits on the right (RTL start) of the label. The AI badge moved to the right, which is defensible and documented in the header. Exports and the 108-frame duration are unchanged. The header comment is accurate. No leftover English text apart from the AI mark.
